action_items: Fix useEffect for additional_items: add check for isLoadingEdit OR add a flag to distinguish BD-loaded items from manually-created items
Suggested fix: Add isFromDB: true flag to items in mapAdditionalItem, and skip propagation for items with isFromDB=true during initial load
Alternative fix: Move the 500ms setTimeout for isLoadingEdit to after all useEffects have settled
critical_code_review_comments: Lines 242-253: The comment says 'Estos siempre deben actualizarse' but this breaks edit functionality. Items loaded from BD should only update when user manually changes header AFTER initial load.
The isLoadingEdit approach works for recurring_basic (via isDefault check) but not for additional items which have no such check

success_rate.frontend: 60% - recurring_basic isAutoLinked items FIXED, but additional items still broken

context_for_next_testing_agent: The fix for mapService isAutoLinked works. But additional_items in useEffect need a similar mechanism to prevent header propagation on initial load. Suggest adding isFromDB flag or changing the logic to only propagate when isEditing && !isLoadingEdit && user actually changed the header (track header changes separately).

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The useEffect for additional_items (lines 242-253) propagates header values unconditionally after isLoadingEdit becomes false
rca_of_the_issue.why_recurring_basic_works: recurring_basic items have isDefault && !isAutoLinked check which skips propagation for auto-linked items
rca_of_the_issue.why_additional_fails: additional_items block has NO similar check - it always propagates to all items when values differ from header
rca_of_the_issue.suggested_fix: Add similar logic to additional_items: only propagate to items that were manually created (not loaded from DB). Could use isFromDB flag in mapAdditionalItem
